title: Coverage surge matrix & rotation roster (Nov 2026 ad-hoc)
content:
Purpose: quick, readable spreadsheet to assign short-notice coverage for potential traffic surge window (Nov 7–10, 2026). Use as single-pane during the sweep — lightweight and intentionally hand-editable.

Key notes/assumptions:
- Surge expected from a pilot partner with heavy embedding/long-context traffic; 10–15% increase to token QPS for hosted and dedicated pools.
- Objective: ensure each surface has a primary+backup contact for daytime coverage (PST overlap) and an explicit escalation path for SLA/latency regressions.
- This is NOT the full runbook; link to playbooks in linked_artifacts.

Sheet (rows):
Columns: Area | Primary owner | Backup | Coverage window (PST) | Coverage hours committed | SLA risk (low/med/high) | Key metric to watch | Next check-in | Immediate action items / notes

1) Hosted API | Marc Chen | Elena Rossi | 06:00–18:00 | 12 | medium | 95th p90 latency, error rate | 2026-11-07 08:30 | Confirm burst capacity toggle + observe prefix-cache hit rate; test synthetic long prompt at 07:45

2) Dedicated (prod pools) | Samir Gupta | Aisha Patel | 05:00–17:00 | 12 | high | queue depth, GPU util per shard | 2026-11-07 07:00 | Reserve one extra shard for priority customers; flag autoscale cooldown adjustments; validate fallback variant mapping

3) Private (VPC customers) | Lena Ortiz | Marc Chen | 07:00–15:00 | 8 | low | instance heartbeat, control-plane errors | 2026-11-07 09:00 | Confirm customer-side TLS cert rotation window; ensure docs reflect private fallback steps

4) Serving-runtime (kernels/batching) | Anders Li | Samir Gupta | 04:00–16:00 | 12 | high | average tokens/sec per worker, kv-cache hit rate | 2026-11-07 06:00 | Hotfix branch ready; if p95 latency > target for 10m, force early rollback to last-good kernel set

5) Console & Rollouts | Elena Rossi | Product PM (TBD) | 08:00–18:00 | 10 | medium | dashboard freshness, rollout failures | 2026-11-07 10:00 | Pause any non-critical rollouts; prioritize route inspection dashboards

6) Observability/Tracing | Priya N. (on call) | SRE rotation | 00:00–23:59 | 24 | medium | span sampling rate, ingestion lag | 2026-11-07 05:00 | Increase sampling on suspect routes for 4h windows; keep retention short for quick scans

7) SRE (infra & networking) | Daniel Park | SRE backup | 00:00–23:59 | 24 | high | network egress errors, k8s pod crashloops | 2026-11-07 04:30 | Pre-warm NAT gateways in secondary region; validate cross-region fallback path

8) Solutions Eng / Customer Success (partner liaison) | Rachel Kim | SE backup | 06:00–14:00 | 8 | low | partner error tickets | 2026-11-07 11:00 | Keep CSM channel open; share synthetic test plan with partner; collect first-hour usage snapshot

Quick tally / checks: 
- Total heads allocated (primary): 8
- Total backup heads: 8
- 24h SRE/Obs coverage is mandatory for this window.
- Dedicated pools flagged as high risk; prioritize pre-warm and reserve capacity.

Escalation flow (short): 
- 1) Primary owner triages and posts to #incidents-surge with short summary + metric snapshot
- 2) If unresolved after 10 minutes or p95 latency degrades > 30%: notify SRE on-call and MD (see linked_artifacts for names)
- 3) If customer-visible SLA breach: exec pager + customer success notify (CS shared template linked)

Action items (owner | due):
- Samir: reserve one extra dedicated shard and document shard id -> due 2026-11-06 18:00
- Marc: run long-context synthetic test against hosted API (5 prompts) -> due 2026-11-07 07:45
- Anders: ensure kernel rollback playbook is pinned and tested in staging -> due 2026-11-06 20:00
- Priya: bump span sampling on routes /redwood/generate/* for first 4 hours -> due 2026-11-07 05:00
- Lena: confirm private deployment TLS rotations are no-op during window -> due 2026-11-06 16:00

Open questions / risks: 
- If burst persists > 6 hours, do we have a budget approval path for on-demand cloud GPUs? (Finance contact needed)
- Which partner paths should be throttled first (embeddings vs. chat)? Need product guidance by 2026-11-06 EOD.
- Is there capacity headroom in APAC region if we shift traffic? Network egress and latency tradeoffs must be validated.

Notes-to-self / quick edits: 
- This sheet is intentionally compact; keep single-page for Pager/Slack copy-paste.
- After the window, convert to postmortem stub with tagged metrics and decisions.

Post-window checklist (short):
- 1) Collect 1h/3h/12h snapshots and paste to postmortem stub.
- 2) Confirm any rollbacks and their timestamps.
- 3) Update capacity playbook if manual reserve used.
- 4) Mark this doc with final status and link PM/Finance decisions.

Revision history (manual):
- 2026-11-02 A.Patel created initial matrix
- 2026-11-03 M.Chen updated Hosted API actions after partner call
- 2026-11-04 S.Gupta added Dedicated shard reservation note

End of sheet.
